material_decisions_and_assumptions: Enforced strict UTC timezone validation; naive datetime inputs raise ValueError.
Used ROW_NUMBER() windowing over (entity_id, metric_name, event_time_utc) ordered by ingested_at_utc DESC, revision_num DESC.

Enforced full 8-timestamp bitemporal predicate: valid_from_utc <= cutoff_ts AND (valid_to_utc IS NULL OR valid_to_utc > cutoff_ts) AND ingested_at_utc <= cutoff_ts AND (superseded_at_utc IS NULL OR superseded_at_utc > cutoff_ts) AND tombstone_status = 'ACTIVE'.

Decoupled raw source payloads into data/payloads/vendor=<vendor>/<sha256>.json so P1-10 GDPR/retention erasure nulls metric_value and deletes raw payload blobs without altering bitemporal audit row counts.
